answer.justification: After alveolar injury, type II pneumocytes proliferate and differentiate into type I pneumocytes to restore the alveolar lining; they also secrete surfactant. Ciliated and goblet cells are airway epithelium (mucociliary clearance/mucus), and club cells regenerate bronchiolar epithelium, not alveoli.
